data.navTitle: 头戴设备、软件安装牌与建议夹
data.title: A headset on the last counter
data.goal: A headset on the last counter
data.situation:
The last counter offered a virtual reality demonstration. A sophisticated headset was capable of presenting a simulated room, while a versatile controller could be used for several actions. The guide called the new system state-of-the-art but still showed Jo the installation notes. Maya held a physical model of the same room and compared it with the view in the headset. The model was tangible: she could touch its walls. A folder beside the counter explained how the team would incorporate visitor feedback. Some earlier suggestions had already been incorporated into the revised design. Jo: Is the virtual room a physical model?
Guide: You see a simulation through the headset. Maya has the physical model.
Maya: Will you incorporate the comments?
Guide: We will review them. This folder shows the changes already made.

readingBlocks.zh: 最后一张台提供虚拟现实演示。精密头戴设备能展示模拟房间，多功能控制器可用于几个动作。讲解员说新系统处于技术前沿，但仍让乔看安装说明。玛雅拿着同一房间的实体模型，与头戴设备中的视图比较。模型是有形可触的，她能碰到墙。柜台旁的文件夹说明团队如何把游客反馈纳入设计，一些此前建议已纳入修改版。

glossary.zh: 通过计算机形成可感知、可交互模拟环境的虚拟现实
glossary.note: 虚拟现实；不同系统需要的设备不同，手套并非必需。
glossary.example: The counter offered a virtual reality demonstration.
glossary.exampleZh: 柜台提供虚拟现实演示。

externalEvidence.definition: a hypothetical three-dimensional visual world created by a computer; user wears special goggles and fiber optic gloves etc., and can enter and move about in this world and interact with objects as if inside it

glossary.note: 这里指设备或软件复杂、精密。
glossary.example: The sophisticated headset presented a simulated room.
glossary.exampleZh: 精密头戴设备展示模拟房间。

externalEvidence.definition: ahead in development; complex or intricate

glossary.note: capable of + 名词或动名词，如 capable of running the program。
glossary.example: The headset was capable of presenting a simulated room.

glossary.zh: 可用于多种用途的；多功能的
glossary.note: 设备有多种用途；人物也可用此词表示多才多艺。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Object having several uses; not force human talent definition.

glossary.zh: 采用当前最先进技术或方法的
glossary.note: 在所描述的时期达到最先进水平；技术仍会更新。
glossary.example: The guide described the system as state-of-the-art.
glossary.exampleZh: 讲解员说系统采用前沿技术。

externalEvidence.definition: the highest level of development at a particular time (especially the present time)

glossary.zh: 将设备或软件安装到可用状态的过程
glossary.note: 这里指软件或设备安装；install 是动词。

externalEvidence.definition: the act of installing something (as equipment)

glossary.zh: 实际存在、可看见或触碰的实体的
glossary.note: 这里表示实体的；与数字或虚拟形式对照。

externalEvidence.definition: having substance or material existence; perceptible to the senses

glossary.note: 可以触摸的；也可说 tangible evidence，具体可见的证据。

externalEvidence.definition: perceptible by the senses especially the sense of touch

glossary.zh: 把某物纳入整体，使其成为一部分
glossary.note: incorporate A into B：把 A 纳入或融入 B。
glossary.example: The team would incorporate visitor feedback.

externalEvidence.definition: make into a whole or make part of a whole

glossary.note: be incorporated into：被纳入；如建议被纳入报告。
glossary.example: Some suggestions had been incorporated into the design.

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Passive incorporation and into preposition explicitly supported by official examples.
